# reblocke/vr_icu

Purpose: Stata and Quarto workflow for "Immersive Virtual Reality Use in Medical Intensive Care: Mixed Methods Feasibility Study."

Canonical article records:
- Final article: https://games.jmir.org/2024/1/e62842/
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.2196/62842
- PubMed: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39046869/
- PMCID: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11344185/
- Preprint record: https://preprints.jmir.org/preprint/62842

Repository:
- GitHub: https://github.com/reblocke/vr_icu
- Citation metadata: CITATION.cff
- Human README: README.md
- Agent instructions: AGENTS.md
- Data dictionary: data_dictionary.md and data_dictionary.csv

What is here:
- VR_ICU.do: Stata 18 analysis script for restricted local study data.
- VR Consort Diagram.qmd: Quarto document for the enrollment flow diagram.
- data_dictionary.md and data_dictionary.csv: documentation for expected restricted inputs and derived variables.

Restricted data:
- Participant-level data are not public and are intentionally not committed.
- Expected local input files are data/ICU_patient_database.xlsx, data/ICU_selection_database.xlsx, and data/hr_data.xlsx.
- Data access follows the article data availability statement and requires IRB-approved request.

How to run:
- Main Stata command: stata-mp -b do VR_ICU.do
- Optional explicit arguments: stata-mp -b do VR_ICU.do data outputs/stata
- Quarto diagram command after Stata: quarto render "VR Consort Diagram.qmd"
- Generated outputs go under outputs/stata/ and outputs/figures/.

Machine-reader cautions:
- Do not infer that local generated outputs are current unless produced by the current commit.
- Do not add PHI, restricted data, credentials, private IRB materials, or publisher-formatted PDFs.
- Link the final article, preprint, and PMC records; do not mirror full manuscript text here.
- The preprint record is linked for provenance. The final peer-reviewed article is the preferred citation.
